author: Philip K. Dick
card_summary: PKD's only children's book: a boy and his outlawed cat emigrate to Plowman's Planet, where a vast being called the Glimmung rules — a young-reader cousin to Galactic Pot-Healer.
page_summary:
On a future Earth where keeping a pet is illegal, young Nick and his family emigrate to Plowman's Planet to save their cat Horace. The new world is full of strange creatures — spiddles, wubs, printers, father-things — and dominated by the Glimmung, an enormous and powerful entity whose designs the boy and his cat are drawn into.

This is a children's book, PKD's only one, written in the 1960s and not published until the late 1980s, after his death. It shares its world and its brooding cosmic figure with the adult novel Galactic Pot-Healer, recasting the Glimmung for young readers as an adventure antagonist. The playful invented bestiary and the plot of ordinary characters caught up in a huge being's project show PKD's imagination working in a lighter key, while keeping the outsized, ambiguous power that recurs across his fiction.
